units.source_text: 后来我明白了，她们的巡回演出日子并不像我最初想象的那么艰辛，而是无忧无虑的，旅途上更是悠闲自在。

en.t: Later I came to understand that their days on tour were not as hard as I had first imagined, but carefree, and on the road they were even more relaxed and at ease.

units.source_text: 他们是母女兄妹，一缕骨肉之情把他们联结在一起。

en.t: They were mother and daughter, brother and sister, bound together by a thread of family affection.

units.source_text: 只有雇来的百合子总是那么腼腆，在我面前常常少言寡语。

en.t: Only Yuriko, who had been hired to join them, was always so shy, and in front of me she was often quiet and said very little.
